name: Fly In Formation (Teamwork)
body:
You are skilled at flying together with your companions.

Prerequisite(s): Fly speed

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on Fly checks and you improve the maneuverability of your fly speed by one step while adjacent to a flying ally with this feat. If an adjacent ally with this feat would fall, and you have a free hand or other grasping appendage, you can catch them as an immediate action. If you are flying with a heavy load, or your ally’s additional weight would put you at a heavy load, you both begin to fall slowly towards the ground at a rate of 60 feet per round and take no damage upon landing.
